text: EX-004: gaps addressed. (1) differentViews.spec.js — MODERN_CLIENT incompatibility constraint captured (widget does NOT support Mendix modern React client, targets classic Dojo client only). (2) dataTypes.spec.js — documented integer, long, decimal support with locale-aware formatting (e.g. 2,147,483,647) as a behavioral constraint on value prop. (3) onClick.spec.js — all action types confirmed: microflow, nanoflow, open page, open modal popup, close page. Sections added for all three e2e files.
